unit: USD per million tokens; Paid Tier, Standard (interactive) inference, text input; no Batch/Flex/Priority. On the Free Tier the same calls are billed at $0, so these figures are list-price estimates, not charges.
caching: Implicit caching is on by default for Gemini 2.5 and newer (https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/caching); cached prompt tokens are billed at cacheRead. The explicit cache storage price ($/1M tokens per hour) is not modelled because the factory uses no explicit cachedContents.
